pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. Represent the abstract Catalan verb ESTAR, being located somewhere, as a clear learned AAC symbol. A complete simple house in open cutaway view, showing a full-body casually dressed adult standing STILL inside the room. One bright red location pin is directly above the adult, inside the boundaries of the room, and one small red arrow points into that room. Convey 'being here in this place', no walking motion, no facial emotion emphasis. Pure white background, ample margins. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.

alt.ca: Una persona quieta dins una habitació, destacada amb un marcador de lloc, representa estar en un indret.
alt.es: Una persona quieta dentro de una habitación, destacada con un marcador de lugar, representa estar en un sitio.
